name: Sembawang Park Dog Run
note: One of the largest dog run in Singapore and it has a seperate area for smaller breeds and shaded spots. However do note that there is no dedicated lighting. Located beside Battleship playground and the nearest carpark is Sembawang Park Car Park 2.

name: Punggol Waterway Park Dog Run (PWP Dog Run)
note: Located within the scenic Punggol Waterway Park and offers a generous space and peaceful backdrop of greenary and the waterway. Nearest carpark is Car Park A.

name: Woodlands Waterfront Park Dog Run
note: Offers scenic coastal views and area is surrounded by shaded spots. Nearest carpark is Woodlands Waterfront Car Park.

name: Yishun Park Dog Run
note: Two small enclosures nestled within Yishun Park, in a neighbourhood setting. Most carparks are quite a distance away (HDB MSCPs, etc).

name: K9 Park @ NEX
hours: 10.30am - 10.30pm (however, please do check mall operating hours too)
note: Located within NEX's rooftop area (Level 4R) and note that pets are not allowed in common areas such as escalators or regular lifts. To access the K9 park, there is a dedicated pet lift from 1st floor. Carparking spaces can be found within NEX too.

name: Sun Plaza Park Dog Run
note: Peaceful and quaint area. Nearest carpark would be various HDB MSCPs.

id: East Coast Park Dog Run (Parkland Green)
name: East Coast Park Dog Run (Parkland Green)
address: Parkland Green, East Coast Park Service Rd, Singapore 449875
note: Probably the largest dog run in the east region, offering 2 enclosures with varying sizes (~500sqm and ~800sqm) with scenic beach views. Nearest carpark is Car Park C1.

name: Tampines Boulevard Park Dog Run
note: Do note that the Dog Run is located along Tampines Avenue 12 at Tampines Boulevard Park (East). Nearest carpark would be various HDB MSCPs.

name: Katong Park Dog Run Park
note: Located within Katong Park and known to be quiet and peaceful. Do note that the Dog Run is located along Tampines Avenue 12 at Tampines Boulevard Park (East) and that dedicated lights is only till 10pm. Carparks are not exactly accessible as neighbouring residentials are condos.

name: Pasir Ris Park Dog Run
note: Located within Pasir Ris Park Area 4 and it offers great coastal views. Nearest carpark is Car Park E.

name: Dog Run at Kembangan
note: Nestled within Lengkong Enam Park and is surrounded by green shades and lush greeneries. As this is within a landed housing estate, parking spaces are limited to roadside lots.

name: Dog Run @ Opera Estate
note: Located in Opera Estate Football Field and is surrounded by green shades and lush greeneries. Parking spaces is limited to available roadside lots within the landed housing estate.

name: Bedok Town Park Dog Run
note: Tucked within Bedok Town Park and can be conveniently accessed via the pedestrian link bridge. Nearest carpark would be various HDB MSCPs.

name: Telok Kurau Dog Run
note: Located within the Telok Kurau Park,a popular neighbourhood spot for families with dog. Limited roadside parking is available within the landed housing estate.

name: West Coast Park Dog Run
note: One of Singapore's largest dog runs, it is well equipped and offers a generous amount of space. Do note that it is a single zone area and there are no big small separation zones. Nearest carpark is West Coast Park Carpark 1.

name: Jurong Lake Gardens Dog Run
note: Situated within Jurong Lake Gardens, it offers a big small seperation zone and is generous with its space. It is most accessible via South Carpark.

name: Dog Run @ Villa Verde Park
note: Located at Villa Verde Bridge, it serves as a cozy gathering spot for families with pets. Most carparks are quite a distance away (HDB MSCPs, etc).

name: Dog Run @ Clementi Woods Park
note: Tucked away gem in the west that offers a serene and calm environment. The dog run is next to West Coast plaza and might not be directly visible on Google Maps. Nearest carpark is Car park (C41). Alternatively, carparking spaces can also be found within West Coast Plaza too

name: Bukit Gombak Park Dog Run
note: Nestled within Bukit Gombak Park, it is accessible through a series of stairs and is surrounded by lush greenary. Nearest carpark is Carpark @ Bukit Gombak Park. Otherwise, carparking spaces can also be found around nearby HDB MSCPs too.

name: Dog Run @ Bishan Park
note: Located within Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park, it is spacious and well equppied and comes with a big small seperation zone. One of the largest dog run in the central region. The most convenient nearby carpark is Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park Car Park A.

name: Dog Run @ 127 TPY
note: Adjacent to Plaza @128, it provides dog owners in Toa Payoh with a convenient and comfortable space for their pets to play. The most convenient carpark is TPTP27 Car Park.

name: Dog Park at Upp Serangoon 21
note: Situated beside Potong Pasir MRT, located in a friendly neighbourhood setting. Multiple carparking spaces in the HDB vicinity.

name: Dog Run @ Tiong Bahru Park
note: Located beside Gan Eng Seng School, this is a convenient and acessible space for nearby residents with pets. Convenient parking options are available within the surrounding HDBs.
